description: Source code for a worker that handles resending invitation emails in the Mattermost server, including job processing, email/channel data cleaning, and job lifecycle management.

classes.name: ResendInvitationEmailWorker
classes.description: Worker responsible for processing resend invitation email jobs, managing job lifecycle, and invoking email resend logic.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new ResendInvitationEmailWorker instance.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker loop, processing jobs and handling stop signals.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if email invitations are enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Signals the worker to stop processing.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Processes a single job, resending emails if the scheduled time has elapsed.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Marks a job as successfully completed.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Marks a job as failed with an error.

methods.name: cleanEmailData
methods.description: Parses email list JSON string into a slice of emails.

methods.name: cleanChannelsData
methods.description: Parses channel list JSON string into a slice of channel IDs.

methods.name: removeAlreadyJoined
methods.description: Filters out emails of users already in the team.

methods.name: GetDurations
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time since job scheduling and the maximum duration for resend.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Deletes job data and marks the job as successful.

methods.name: ResendEmails
methods.description: Resends invitation emails to the specified list, handling errors and data cleaning.
